the study of medium modified leading hadron, jet, sub-jet and di-hadron observables in a single formalism and their comparison to experimental data.
the study of medium modified leading hadrons and jets, and their substructure, within the framework of the higher-twist energy-loss formalism.
the study of the modification of the hadron and jet production spectra in heavy ion collisions.

the energy loss formalism, which is based on the higher-twist formalism, provides a good description of experimental measurements of jet modification, jet sub-structure, and high-$p_\mathrm{ T}$ single-hadron spectra.
the energy loss formalism provides an excellent description of the medium modification of jets and sub-jet structure in $p$-Pb and Pb-Pb collisions.

we are able to reproduce the data from a wide range of collision systems, from $p$-$A$ and $A-A$ to heavy ion collisions at LHC energies, within a single theoretical framework.

the energy loss formalism provides a consistent framework to describe the medium modification of leading hadrons, sub-jets and jets.
